rationale: A third party (neighbor's child) suffered a serious injury (broken wrist) on the claimant's property; liability coverage applies to injury of others arising from conditions on the insured's premises.
claim_summary: Policy POL-1002 (Jamie Chen, homeowners with liability, $500K limit, $1K deductible, active): Neighbor's nine-year-old daughter slipped and fell on claimant's front walkway during an ice storm last week, sustaining a broken wrist. Parents are discussing medical bills. Classified as high-severity liability claim with 0.9 confidence due to third-party injury on insured premises. Requires liability adjuster review for coverage determination and damages assessment.

case_facts.location: Walkway in front of claimant's house
case_facts.description: Neighbor's nine-year-old daughter slipped and fell on icy walkway
